title: Science Formulation Wave 014 — Closure, Sufficiency, Stability and Advancement Frontiers
purpose: Deepen existing Potatoverse science models by adding exact closure conditions, decision sufficiency, conservation ledgers, fixed-point stability, practical identifiability and Pareto advancement rules rather than introducing new named theory layers.

records.main_contribution: Orders projections as statistical experiments using stochastic garbling and decision sufficiency rather than one scalar information score.
records.strongest_result: If a representation is a garbling of another, its optimal Bayes risk cannot be lower for the same decision problem; dimensional reductions may also be genuinely incomparable across tasks.

records.main_contribution: Distinguishes strict Axis/time commutation from Frobenius integrability and from genuine two-flow non-closure; sharpens Door crossing versus grazing versus bifurcation.
records.strongest_result: [F,A] may be nonzero yet remain inside span{F,A}; only its component outside that distribution proves the two-flow description is dynamically incomplete.

records.main_contribution: Adds a finite-horizon stock-flow ledger, exact release/loss fractions, positivity/stability, bandwidth and minimal-realization conditions.
records.strongest_result: For an isolated linear store, the initial stock partitions exactly into useful release eta/(eta+Gamma) and loss Gamma/(eta+Gamma); extra hidden stores must earn themselves through reproducible poles plus controllability/observability.

records.main_contribution: Reduces the selected Q=xi H rho_c benchmark to an exact density-ratio phase equation and derives fixed-point stability.
records.strongest_result: For constant w<0 in the chosen sign convention, every physically positive nonzero scaling point is unstable; the simplest interaction therefore does not automatically solve the coincidence problem.

records.main_contribution: Separates structural and practical identifiability, adds Fisher/local-sloppiness diagnostics, profile likelihood and measurement-design logic.
records.strongest_result: A Human Map prediction can be identifiable even when internal parameters are not; predictive usefulness does not license interpretation of unconstrained latent parameters.

records.main_contribution: Recasts Laniakea shear with frame-invariant J2/J3 descriptors and separates anisotropy magnitude, eigenvalue shape and principal-axis direction.
records.strongest_result: The existing A_sigma statistic is sqrt(3 J2)/|theta|; a normalized third invariant chi_3 adds independent shear-shape information without pretending to measure boundary morphology.

records.main_contribution: Defines advancement as a Pareto problem across comparable defect, robustness and complexity coordinates rather than a universal weighted score.
records.strongest_result: A richer theory that is observationally equivalent to a simpler one is scientifically redundant for that task unless its additional structure is independently measured or useful for another declared target.

new_negative_results: Projection/reconstruction is bounded by fiber ambiguity and decision information cannot improve under pure garbling.
Axis and time need not commute to form a coherent two-dimensional leaf, but failure of Frobenius closure reveals missing state directions.
Stock-only Spudlight observations cannot uniquely separate release and loss, and passive storage cannot output more physical stock than initial-plus-input budget.
The selected constant-w Q=xi H rho_c Cosmic Soil model has no stable positive nonzero scaling point for w<0 under its current sign convention.
A full-rank/local Fisher approximation is not sufficient evidence of globally or practically identified Human Map parameters.
Strong Laniakea shear magnitude does not determine shear eigenvalue shape, principal-axis direction or geometric boundary morphology.
No universal scalar quality score is needed: dominated and observationally redundant models can be stopped using a Pareto/defect framework.
shared_formulation_pattern: state the map or flow -> derive closure/invariant/fixed point -> identify nuisance or hidden degrees -> state a measurable defect -> compare with a simpler model -> promote, retain as approximation, or downgrade
next_decisive_work: Build a synthetic projection ladder and demonstrate a representation with high reconstruction error but zero task-information/decision loss.
Construct an explicit Potato Dynamics example in which [F,A] is nonzero but involutive, plus one example where the bracket generates a third direction.
Fit one-store versus two-store Spudlight dynamics to a public stock/flux time series with calibrated input and at least one intermediate measurement.
If Cosmic Soil remains active, choose one perturbation-complete covariant transfer prescription rather than adding more background Q forms.
For Human Map, use synthetic recovery to compare Fisher and profile-likelihood diagnostics under nonlinear/latent confounding.
For Cosmic Potato, propagate the full shear covariance/posterior into J2,J3,A_sigma and chi_3 and compare reconstruction pipelines.

Apply Pareto stop rules to the full science completion matrix and explicitly mark models as promoted, frontier, approximation-only, underidentified, nonclosed, redundant, dominated or rejected-in-regime.
relationship_to_previous_waves: Wave 013 introduced defect-oriented formulation. Wave 014 deepens that approach by proving stronger ordering/closure results, deriving an exact negative fixed-point result, separating latent prediction from parameter identifiability, and adding non-scalar research advancement governance.
